script: Killer whales are actually the largest members of the dolphin family. Big males can grow up to about 9 meters long. They live in close family groups led by older females. Different groups use their own sets of calls, a bit like accents. Some groups work together to make waves that wash seals off floating ice. Female orcas can live for 80 years or more.
